attribution.note: Exact words from Zitron's own newsletter post 'Burst Damage' (2024-08-05), written in his own voice and endorsed.

semantics.note: The normalisation keeps the antecedent and the embedded belief ('which I believe it will'). The consequent is 'will face serious pressure'. It is a conditional forecast with a figurative antecedent, an undefined consequent, and no horizon.

contract.note: The contract rightly treats 'albatross' as a metaphor with no test, 'serious pressure' as unmeasured, and notes there is no deadline. Any scoring would rest on interpretation the speaker did not supply, so not_applicable is fair.

output.rationale: The antecedent is figurative and its status cannot be established. Under policy, an unknown antecedent means the conditional is not scored. The consequent ('serious pressure') has no measure, and no horizon was stated. The embedded belief is equally untestable. No evidence was gathered, and none could meet a criterion. The claim is not adjudicable.
